must_fix.title: Dialog does not restore focus to the trigger when a child uses autoFocus
must_fix.evidence: src/Dialog.tsx:68 captures document.activeElement in useEffect, after React has applied autoFocus inside the dialog, so it records the dialog's own input; the effect also overrides autoFocus. Probe: trigger button opens <Dialog open title="T"><button>a</button><input autoFocus/></Dialog>, then Escape -> output 'P1 focused inside: BUTTON' / 'P1 after close focus: BODY trigger'. The issue requires focus to return to whatever had it before opening.

must_fix.title: Tabs enabled-list goes stale when a Tab's disabled prop changes without TabList re-rendering, leaving no reachable tab stop
must_fix.evidence: src/Tabs.tsx:89-92 refreshes enabledValues only in TabList's layout effect. A Tab wrapped in a component with local state that toggles disabled -> 'P2 [ [ 'a', true, 0 ], [ 'b', false, -1 ] ]': the disabled tab keeps tabIndex 0 and every other tab is -1, so the tablist can't be reached by keyboard.

must_fix.title: Uncontrolled Tabs without defaultValue change selection when tabs are inserted or disabled, without calling onValueChange
must_fix.evidence: src/Tabs.tsx:65 recomputes the selection each render as enabledValues[0] instead of storing it. Inserting <Tab value="z"> before 'a' on rerender -> 'P3 before [ 'true', 'false' ]' then 'P3 after [ 'z:true', 'a:false', 'b:false' ] []': the selection moved to a different tab and onValueChange was never called.

nits: Test names carry spec tags like (C1), (D4), (G1) that refer to a document not in the repo.
'No results' is an li with role=presentation inside the listbox; a live region would announce it more reliably.
Tab overrides a consumer-supplied id, and TabPanel overrides id and tabIndex, although the README says remaining props are passed through.
The focus trap's tabbable query ignores contenteditable and doesn't treat radio groups as a single tab stop.

report:
I'd send this back. Tests and typecheck pass, but the dialog doesn't always return focus where the issue says it must, and two Tabs behaviours are broken.

**What I ran**
- `pnpm test`: 4 files, 90 tests, all passed.
- `pnpm typecheck` (`tsc --noEmit`): clean.
- The repo has no lint or format config, so there was nothing else to run.
- For edge cases I wrote a temporary probe, `tests/zz_probe.test.tsx`, ran it with `npx vitest run tests/zz_probe.test.tsx`, then deleted it. `git status` is the same as when I started.

**Must fix**

1. **Dialog loses focus on close when a child uses `autoFocus`.** The issue says focus returns to "whatever had it before opening". `src/Dialog.tsx:68` records the previously focused element inside a `useEffect`. React has already applied `autoFocus` by then, so the dialog records its own input. That input is gone after close, so focus drops to `<body>`. The effect also moves focus to the first tabbable element, overriding `autoFocus`. I tested `<Dialog open title="T"><button>a</button><input autoFocus/></Dialog>`, opened from a trigger button, then pressed Escape:
   ```
   P1 focused inside: BUTTON
   P1 after close focus: BODY trigger
   ```
   The fix is to capture `document.activeElement` before the dialog's children commit (for example during render or in a layout effect of `Dialog` itself).

2. **Tabs can drop out of the tab order completely.** The list of enabled tabs is only refreshed in `TabList`'s `useLayoutEffect` (`src/Tabs.tsx:89-92`). If a `Tab`'s `disabled` prop changes without `TabList` re-rendering, the list goes stale. That happens when a wrapper component with its own state renders the `Tab`. The disabled tab then keeps `tabIndex=0` and every other tab has `-1`. A disabled button can't take focus, so keyboard users can't reach the tablist:
   ```
   P2 [ [ 'a', true, 0 ], [ 'b', false, -1 ] ]
   ```

3. **Uncontrolled Tabs change selection without user action and without calling `onValueChange`.** With no `defaultValue`, the selected tab is never stored. It is recomputed each render as "first enabled tab" (`src/Tabs.tsx:65`). So if the user hasn't clicked a tab yet and a tab is inserted in front, or the first tab becomes disabled, the selection moves to a different tab and `onValueChange` is never called:
   ```
   P3 before [ 'true', 'false' ]
   P3 after [ 'z:true', 'a:false', 'b:false' ] []
   ```

**Checked and working**
- Dialog under StrictMode (focus moves in and comes back).
- A Combobox with no matching options, and ArrowDown after clearing the text.
- Escape inside a Combobox in a Dialog closes only the listbox.
- Nested dialogs only respond in the topmost one.

**Nits**
- Test names carry tags like `(C1)`, `(D4)`, `(G1)` that point to a spec document not in the repo.
- The `"No results"` item has `role="presentation"` inside the listbox, so screen readers may not announce it; a live region would be more reliable.
- `Tab` silently overwrites any `id` passed by the consumer, and `TabPanel` does the same with `id` and `tabIndex`. The README says remaining props are "passed to" the element without mentioning this.
- The focus trap's list of focusable elements ignores `contenteditable` and doesn't treat radio groups as a single stop.
